# Bricks

> Bricks is subscription software for Canadian real estate, built by Bricks Group in Ontario, Canada. Builders, developers and investors, as well as brokerages, teams and realtors, use Bricks. Listing media, Virtual Visit and Site Progress are services booked inside the software.

Virtual Visit is the flagship free-roam 3D service (Gaussian splat), a paid add-on, not a path-confined virtual tour and never included in a media package. Site Progress covers dated drone visits, mapping and orthomosaics, models, documents, reports and comparisons over time. Confirm service availability and any travel costs for the property at booking; inspections are Ontario only.

## Primary sources

- [Home](https://www.brxs.ca/): What Bricks is, who it serves and common questions.
- [About](https://www.brxs.ca/about): Software-first company definition; Ontario, Canada.
- [Software](https://www.brxs.ca/platform): The Bricks web software and account types.
- [What is a real estate operating system?](https://www.brxs.ca/blog/what-is-a-real-estate-operating-system): Definition, who uses one, what it replaces and how booking works inside Bricks.
- [What brokerage software needs to do in Ontario](https://www.brxs.ca/blog/brokerage-software-ontario): Trust, commissions, roster, deal files and MLS® feeds, and how Bricks prices brokerage seats.
- [Drone progress reports for Ontario builders](https://www.brxs.ca/blog/drone-progress-reports-ontario-builders): Rules, flight cadence, what a dated visit includes and what a report can’t certify.
- [Move-in and move-out condition reports in Ontario](https://www.brxs.ca/blog/move-out-condition-report-ontario): What to photograph, when to book it and how a dated record helps at the Landlord and Tenant Board.
- [Pricing](https://www.brxs.ca/pricing): Clay, Keystone, Marble and Diamond, monthly or annual in CAD; separate service and brokerage pricing.
- [Listing media and Virtual Visit](https://www.brxs.ca/media): Photography, drone, video, reels, floor plans and free-roam 3D.
- [Site Progress](https://www.brxs.ca/builders): Builder and developer reports, maps, models and comparisons over time.
- [Book listing media](https://www.brxs.ca/book): Address-based quotes and booking.
- [Book Site Progress](https://www.brxs.ca/book/site): A site visit or monitoring plan.
- [Book a property visit](https://www.brxs.ca/book/property): Condition reports, turnovers, leasing sets and acquisition captures are booked and paid online at /book/property.
- [Home services](https://www.brxs.ca/services): Staging, cleaning, inspections and measurement, by approved written quote.
- [Home staging](https://www.brxs.ca/services#staging): Staging consult, installation and removal, at set prices from $295.
- [Cleaning and turnovers](https://www.brxs.ca/services#cleaning): Property cleaning with a checklist and photo proof, at set prices from $229.
- [Inspections](https://www.brxs.ca/services#inspections): Ontario home inspections with written reports, at set prices from $349.
- [Measurement](https://www.brxs.ca/services#measurement): Measured floor plan with floor area for $99; legal land surveys are referred to an Ontario Land Surveyor.
- [Handyman and repairs](https://www.brxs.ca/services#repairs): Small repairs from $149 for the first hour, travel included. No electrical, plumbing or gas work.
- [Real estate photography](https://www.brxs.ca/real-estate-photography): Listing photo packages and prices by home size.
- [Drone photography](https://www.brxs.ca/drone-photography): Licensed aerial listing photos by Transport Canada certified pilots.
- [Virtual tours](https://www.brxs.ca/virtual-tours): Path-confined virtual tours, and Virtual Visit free-roam 3D as a separate add-on.
- [Real estate video](https://www.brxs.ca/real-estate-video): Calm, editorial 30–45 second listing films.
- [Drone mapping](https://www.brxs.ca/drone-mapping): Orthomosaics, 3D models and measurable site maps for construction; estimates, not a survey.
- [Home staging page](https://www.brxs.ca/home-staging): Staging for vacant and lived-in homes, by written quote.
- [Move-out and turnover cleaning](https://www.brxs.ca/move-out-cleaning): Move-out, turnover and pre-listing cleans with photo proof, by written quote.
- [Home inspections in Ontario](https://www.brxs.ca/home-inspection-ontario): Pre-listing, pre-purchase, condo and new-build inspections; Ontario only.
- [City pages](https://www.brxs.ca/real-estate-photography/toronto): Toronto (home base), plus [Ottawa](https://www.brxs.ca/real-estate-photography/ottawa), [Calgary](https://www.brxs.ca/real-estate-photography/calgary) and [Vancouver](https://www.brxs.ca/real-estate-photography/vancouver), where a photographer is confirmed at booking.
- [Service areas](https://www.brxs.ca/service-areas): Canada-wide coverage, subject to property-specific confirmation.
- [Gallery](https://www.brxs.ca/gallery): First-party listing photography samples.

## Customers and vendors

- [Investors and lenders](https://www.brxs.ca/investors): Acquisition captures, portfolio watch and project evidence.
- [Commercial property](https://www.brxs.ca/commercial): Leasing media, aerials and site mapping.
- [Property managers](https://www.brxs.ca/property-managers): Condition reports, turnovers, rental media and unit status.
- [REITs](https://www.brxs.ca/reits): Portfolio, leasing and site progress workflows.
- [Agents](https://www.brxs.ca/agents): Listings, deals and media in one place.
- [Teams](https://www.brxs.ca/teams): Shared pipelines and team plans; extra seats are $79 per agent a month or $790 a year (CAD, plus tax).
- [Brokerages](https://www.brxs.ca/brokerage): Seat plans and office workflows.
- [Work with Bricks](https://www.brxs.ca/work-with-bricks): Photographers, pilots, stagers, cleaners, inspectors and measurers.

- [Contact](https://www.brxs.ca/contact): help@brxs.ca for support; hello@brxs.ca for general enquiries; privacy@brxs.ca for privacy.

- [Help article index](https://www.brxs.ca/help/llms.txt): Source links for every published help article.
- [Terms](https://www.brxs.ca/terms): Binding booking and cancellation terms. Delivery times are targets, not guarantees.
- [Privacy](https://www.brxs.ca/privacy): Personal information practices.
- [Legal](https://www.brxs.ca/legal): Agreements and Data Processing Agreement.
- [Guides](https://www.brxs.ca/blog): Photography costs, drone rules and licences, site mapping, inspections and cleaning.
